fer_fantasy_1.text: Please, don't leave me. We are going to be happy. I promise you, we are going to be happy.

fer_fantasy_2.text: I'm going to do everything I can to make us work.

fer_fantasy_3.text: I'm going to prove it to you. Believe in me. You won't regret it.

fer_fantasy_4.text: I want you more than anything in this world. I'm going to fight for us and for you.

fer_fantasy_5.text: I will live with you. Trust me.

fer_fantasy_6.text: I want you as my girlfriend, my wife, my woman, for the rest of my life.

nav_objective.text: Current objective: drive to Jennifer's house. E T A, forty minutes.

nav_still.text: E T A: still forty minutes.

nav_reroute.text: This is a memory. It is not on the route. Rerouting.

nav_reroute2.text: Rerouting. You were already on the route.

nav_driving.text: Driving. E T A, forty minutes.

fer_decl_2.text: We are going to be happy. I promise you, we are going to be happy.

fer_decl_3.text: I'm going to prove it to you. Believe in me. You won't regret it.

fer_decl_4.text: I'm going to fight for us and for you.

fer_decl_5.text: I'll come get you in person.

fer_decl_6.text: I want you as my girlfriend, my wife, my woman, for the rest of my life.

jen_decl_1.text: Okay. When are you coming over?

jen_decl_4.text: Fernando. I am forty minutes away.

jen_decl_5.text: I asked if you were free this weekend.

jen_love_2.text: Yes. When are you coming over?

jen_love_3.text: Fernando. I am forty minutes away.

jen_love_5.text: I asked if you were free this weekend.

fer_yes_sky.text: She said yes. She said yes to everything. The house. The porch. All of it.

fer_child_1.text: Josephine. Seven. She has her mother's eyes and a better sense of direction than her father.

fer_child_2.text: Johnny. Four. Refuses to get in the car. He gets it from me.

fer_child_3.text: The twins. Names pending. They have opinions about the porch.

fer_child_4.text: Bruno. He is a dog. He counts.

fer_child_5.text: A fifth child. The house has grown to fit them all. The house is not real. I have not driven anywhere.

fer_child_6.text: A sixth. At this point Jennifer would need to be involved. She is forty minutes away.

fer_place_cave.text: The cave. We went caving last spring. She was ahead of me the whole time.

fer_place_bush.text: The forest. Our first walk. She was forty metres ahead of me the whole time.

fer_place_valley.text: The valley. The house on the hill. Our house. Nobody lives there yet.

jos_cave_failed.text: Fernando, I'm not waiting. I'm never waiting.

jos_cave_reached.text: Oh. You caught up. That rock is just a rock, by the way. It's not a ring.

kid_hi2.text: Daddy, hi! We ran the whole way!

fer_kids_forest.text: There they are. They ran the whole way. They have her eyes.

jos_bush_start.text: Come on. It's just up here.

jos_bush_failed.text: It was right there, Fernando. You were looking at a fern.

jos_bush_reached.text: It's a mailbox, Fernando. I know you put our initials on it. It's sweet. It's also a mailbox.

fer_cave_monster.text: It's beautiful. It has your eyes.

jos_valley_start.text: That house? We can't afford that house.

jos_valley_failed.text: You stopped halfway up the hill to feel something. I could see you doing it.

jos_valley_reached.text: Fernando. It's locked. Nobody lives here. Can we go?

fer_leaving.text: I'll come get you in person.

fer_close.text: Jennifer. Close is a relative term. In the sense that matters, I have never been closer to anything.

end_arrived.text: He came. In person. She opened the door and said hi. That was the whole thing. It was enough.

end_bed.text: I asked if you were free this weekend. Then come.

nav_takeoff.text: Recalculating. The road ends here. Taking the air.

fer_flies.text: Of course it flies. Everything I do for her flies.

jen_anywhere.text: Anywhere. Everything is forty minutes from here.
